displayPolicy: Never present aged research as an active trading signal. During refresh, keep the latest candidate visible as display-only and block new buy triggers until a fresh generation arrives.
stockSessionRule: Same-day stock entries require an authoritative regular session and at least 20 minutes to close. Day-trader stock positions enter forced-exit handling from 10 minutes before close and remain there until broker-confirmed flat.

executionWakeBridge.note: This monitor detects triggers without an LLM. The authorized Claude runner consumes the generated dispatch and is the sole Robinhood Trading MCP execution agent.

watchlist.armingRule: After a confirmed same-day buy, persist dayTradeSeedLane=true with the saved protection levels. Keep it ACTIVE until Robinhood confirms flat so forced exits continue to fire.

buyCompetition.rule: Already-qualified A stocks rank before B; within tier, fresh cost-adjusted intraday edge and adjusted score break ties. Intraday intelligence may block/reorder/reduce size but never create eligibility or raise risk.

dayTradeSeedLane.rule: User-authorized same-day stock seed lane, expanded 2026-09-18 at user request for more trades/day and larger size. It reuses the swing seed candidate pool, never overlaps a swing selection, accepts entries only during the authoritative regular session with at least 20 minutes to close (matching the system-wide day-trader policy), and requires repeated forced-exit dispatches from 10 minutes before close until Robinhood confirms the position is flat. Up to a $30 ceiling for A-tier candidates (raised from $20); a B-tier (best-acceptable) candidate is now also day-trade-seed-lane eligible but stays capped at $7.50 (25% of the A-tier ceiling). Up to 5 concurrent positions and 5 new positions per UTC day (raised from 3/3). A fractional-only fill (common at this size) has no broker-resident stop available on Robinhood -- this lane uses the same agent-managed synthetic-stop protection already defined for fractional positions elsewhere (fractionalProtectionPolicy), including its tighter 0.75%-of-equity planned-stop-risk cap and mandatory active-monitoring requirement, rather than requiring an impossible broker-resident stop. Synthetic protection still requires the same <=5 minute active-monitoring cadence during the regular session as the swing lane, separate from this lane's own forced-exit timing. Profit target tightened 2026-09-22 (user-requested day-trade-only phase): target1/target2 for this lane use targetPct1/targetPct2 (2%/3% above entry) instead of the shared swing 1.5R/2.6R geometry, since the goal is small, frequent, same-day gains rather than a multi-day swing target -- stop/invalidation logic is unchanged.

triggerDefinitions.BUY_TRIGGER: Qualified fresh entry zone reached; live broker checks still required.
triggerDefinitions.SEED_LANE_BUY_TRIGGER: An A-tier SHADOW_ONLY stock candidate reached its entry zone. Automatic through Claude Robinhood Trading MCP, capped at $20, existing cash only, and every other live guard remains mandatory.
triggerDefinitions.STOCK_DAY_TRADE_SEED_LANE_BUY_TRIGGER: A non-overlapping A-tier same-day seed candidate reached its entry zone during the regular session with at least 30 minutes to close. Automatic through Claude Robinhood Trading MCP and capped at $20.
triggerDefinitions.STOCK_DAY_TRADE_FORCED_EXIT: A tagged same-day position must be reconciled and closed. This repeats from 15 minutes before close and after the session until Robinhood confirms flat.
triggerDefinitions.CRYPTO_SEED_LANE_BUY_TRIGGER: An A/A+ crypto candidate reached its entry zone. Automatic through Claude Robinhood Trading MCP, capped at $5, existing cash only, one position at a time, and every other live guard remains mandatory.
triggerDefinitions.TRIGGER_1_STOP: Stop/invalidation reached — verify position and sell protected quantity.
triggerDefinitions.TRIGGER_2_TARGET1: Target 1 reached — execute validated first scale-out.
triggerDefinitions.TRIGGER_3_TARGET2: Target 2 reached — execute validated exit/runner decision.
triggerDefinitions.TRIGGER_EARLY_PROFIT_TRIM: Position is up at least 5% from its recorded cost basis, short of the full target — sell roughly half to lock in the gain and free capital, let the remainder run.

creditPolicy: Alpaca/GitHub monitor prices. Claude should read the small dispatch packet first and avoid market/broker work when no action is needed.

profitGivebackPolicy.note: Executor must calculate from fresh broker-confirmed state; repository snapshots never invent PnL.

intradayEngine.policy: Intraday edge may block, reorder, or reduce size but may never create eligibility or increase maximum risk. Stale/unavailable data fails closed for new entries; exits remain prioritized.
